device.description: 16-bit voltage-output DAC with 16-bit parallel interface, input-register read-back, LDAC, RST to min or mid scale, pin-selected power-down and data format
device.note: dac8541.pdf (SLAS353) p.3 logic inputs and power requirements (DVDD 1.8-5.5 V), p.4 pin configuration and terminal functions, p.5 timing characteristics and Figure 1, p.6 reset timing (Figure 2), p.14 control signal summary (Table 1), p.15 data format (Table 2), LDAC, RST/RSTSEL and power-on reset, p.16 power-down modes

registers.name: IN
registers.note: input register; written and read back over DB15-DB0 (Table 1); power-on value not stated, the DAC register powers up at min-scale (reset 0)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; power-on min-scale (code 0000h in straight binary, p.15); loaded on the LDAC rising edge

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: levels of the PD1, PD0, BTC/USB and RSTSEL pins (Tables 1-3)

commands.name: Write input register (CS low, R/W low)
commands.note: Table 1: input data are latched at CS rising (th2 data hold after CS rising, Figure 1)

protocol.note: Table 1: CS low with R/W high presents the input register on DB15-DB0 (td1 80 ns max, th4 20 ns max)

clear.note: rising edge resets the DAC register (not the input register) to min-scale (RSTSEL low) or mid-scale (RSTSEL high), p.15

resetSelect.note: power-on reset to min scale: code 8000h in twos complement (BTC/USB high)

pages: p.3 (logic inputs, power requirements), p.4 (pins), p.5 (timing, Figure 1), p.6 (reset timing), p.14 (Table 1), p.15 (Table 2 data format, LDAC, RST/RSTSEL, power-on reset), p.16 (power-down)
notModeled: analog output, VOUTSense feedback, VREFH/VREFL references (never driven)

RST loads min-scale (RSTSEL low) or mid-scale (RSTSEL high) into the DAC register only; the model's clear also loads the input register. clearCode follows RSTSEL in straight-binary codes (0000h / 8000h); with BTC/USB high the chip loads 8000h (min) / 0000h (mid), which one pin-chosen clear code cannot express

BTC/USB selects 2's complement or straight binary for written and read-back data; the model stores the code as written (CTRL.BTC informational). Power-on (min scale) follows BTC/USB through pins.resetSelect (8000h in 2's complement); the datasheet names the output only, the model applies it to the input register too
PD1/PD0 pin power-down (1 kOhm / 100 kOhm / Hi-Z output) is analog: the pin levels are copied into CTRL only
DAC register is not readable (Table 1 reads the input register)
timing limits tw1-tw7, tsu1-tsu5, th1-th5, td2 and output settling
variants: dac8541.pdf covers only the DAC8541 (32-pin TQFP PBS).
